## Load Dependencies
```{r setup message=FALSE}
sessionpackages <- (c("dplyr", "ggplot2", "MetBrewer", "RColorBrewer", "cowplot", "rmarkdown", "ggh4x", "patchwork", "ggsignif"))
lapply(sessionpackages, library, character.only = TRUE)
```

## Clean Data
```{r}
moa.dat <- read.csv("../../output/Proportion_CellIDPerSample.csv")
moa.dat <- moa.dat %>% dplyr::arrange(Timepoint)
moa.dat <- moa.dat %>% mutate(Cell_Freq = Proportion_idPerSample*100)
moa.dat <- moa.dat %>% filter(!Cell_ID %in% c("Drop", "Unknown Myeloid")) #Remove unknown populations
moa.dat <- moa.dat %>% mutate(Annotation = case_when(Cell_ID == "B-cells" ~ "B-cells",
                                                     Cell_ID == "moDCs" ~ "Alv Mac",
                                                     Cell_ID == "CD4+ T-cells" ~ "CD4+ T",
                                                     Cell_ID == "Ly6C-CD8+ T-cells" ~ "Ly6C-CD8+ T",
                                                     Cell_ID == "Ly6C+CD8+ T-cells" ~ "Ly6C+CD8+ T",
                                                     Cell_ID == "Ly6C+ NK cells" ~ "Ly6C+NK",
                                                     Cell_ID == "Ly6C- NK cells" ~ "Ly6C-NK",
                                                     Cell_ID == "CD103+CD4+ T-cells" ~ "CD103+CD4+ T",
                                                     Cell_ID == "Ly6C(hi)CD64(hi) Monocytes" ~ "iMono",
                                                     Cell_ID == "cDC1" ~ "cDC1",
                                                     Cell_ID == "Monocytes" ~ "Mono",
                                                     Cell_ID == "Neutrophils" ~ "Neut",
                                                     Cell_ID == "CD206+ Macrophages" ~ "CD206+ Mac",
                                                     Cell_ID == "cDC2" ~ "cDC2",
                                                     Cell_ID == "pDCs" ~ "pDC",
                                                     Cell_ID == "CD64+MHCII- Macrophages" ~ "CD64+ Mac")) #Mutate new column for latest annotation.

moa.pre <- moa.dat %>%
  dplyr::filter(Timepoint %in% c("144")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!Treatment %in% c("Pam10ug",
                                  "Hh+NTHi",
                                  "Pam1ug+NTHi",
                                  "Saline+NTHi"))


rm(moa.dat)

moa.pre <- moa.pre %>% 
  mutate(across(c(Treatment), ~ stringr::str_replace_all(.x, "\\bPam1ug\\b", "Pam2CSK4")),
         across(c(Treatment), ~ stringr::str_replace_all(.x, "\\bSaline\\b", "Saline")))

```

## Re-format data into List by Tissue & TAnnotation
```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
unique_combinations <- unique(moa.pre[, c("Tissue", "Annotation")])

subset_list <- list()
for (i in 1:nrow(unique_combinations)) {
                                        g1 <- unique_combinations[i, "Tissue"]
                                        g2 <- unique_combinations[i, "Annotation"]
                                        
                                        # Subset the data frame based on the current combination
                                        current_subset <- moa.pre[moa.pre$Annotation == g2,]                                                                 
                                        
                                        # Store the subset in the list
                                        subset_name <- paste0(g2)
                                        subset_list[[subset_name]] <- current_subset
                                        }
```

```{r}
df.sig <- read.csv("../../output/AllComparisonsIncludingSignificance.csv")

df.sig <- df.sig %>% 
  mutate(across(c(Treatment1, Treatment2), ~ stringr::str_replace_all(.x, "\\bPam1ug\\b", "Pam2CSK4")),
         across(c(Treatment1, Treatment2), ~ stringr::str_replace_all(.x, "\\bSaline\\b", "Saline"))) %>%
  mutate(Annotation = case_when(Cell_ID == "B-cells" ~ "B-cells",
                                Cell_ID == "moDCs" ~ "Alv Mac",
                                Cell_ID == "CD4+ T-cells" ~ "CD4+ T",
                                Cell_ID == "Ly6C-CD8+ T-cells" ~ "Ly6C-CD8+ T",

                                Cell_ID == "Ly6C- NK cells" ~ "Ly6C-NK",
                                Cell_ID == "CD103+CD4+ T-cells" ~ "CD103+CD4+ T",
                                Cell_ID == "Ly6C(hi)CD64(hi) Monocytes" ~ "iMono",
                                Cell_ID == "cDC1" ~ "cDC1",
                                Cell_ID == "Monocytes" ~ "Mono",
                                Cell_ID == "Neutrophils" ~ "Neut",
                                Cell_ID == "CD206+ Macrophages" ~ "CD206+ Mac",
                                Cell_ID == "cDC2" ~ "cDC2",

comparisons <- list(
  # Between treatments with Pretreatment only
   c("Saline", "Hh"), c("Saline", "Pam2CSK4"), c("Hh", "Pam2CSK4"),
  # Between treatments with Pretreatment and IAV
  # c("Hh", "Hh+IAV"), c("Saline", "Saline+IAV"), c("Pam2CSK4", "Pam2CSK4+IAV"),
  # Between treatments with OM-challenge and IAV
  # c("Hh+IAV+NTHi", "Hh+IAV"), c("Saline+IAV+NTHi", "Saline+IAV"), c("Pam2CSK4+IAV+NTHi", "Pam2CSK4+IAV"),
  # Between treatments with OM-challenge and no challenge
  # c("Hh+IAV+NTHi", "Hh"), c("Saline+IAV+NTHi", "Saline"), c("Pam2CSK4+IAV+NTHi", "Pam2CSK4"),
  # Between treatments with IAV-challenge
  c("Saline+IAV", "Hh+IAV"), c("Saline+IAV", "Pam2CSK4+IAV"), c("Hh+IAV", "Pam2CSK4+IAV"),
  # Between treatments with OM-challenge
   c("Saline+IAV+NTHi", "Hh+IAV+NTHi"), c("Saline+IAV+NTHi", "Pam2CSK4+IAV+NTHi"), c("Hh+IAV+NTHi", "Pam2CSK4+IAV+NTHi")
  )

comp_keys <- purrr::map_chr(comparisons, ~ paste(sort(.x), collapse = "|||"))



df.sig.filtered <- df.sig %>%
  mutate(
    pair_key = purrr::map2_chr(Treatment1, Treatment2,
                               ~ paste(sort(c(.x, .y)), collapse = "|||")),
    pair_key = factor(pair_key, levels = comp_keys)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(pair_key)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(pair_key)
```

### Figure 5

```{r}

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)
# library(ggsignif)  # uncomment if not loaded globally

plot_and_save <- function(data_list_element, name, sig_df) {
  message(paste(format(Sys.time(), "%X"), name, sep = " :F3sig: "))
  
  data_list_element <- data_list_element %>%
  mutate(
    Treatment = recode(
      Treatment,
      "Hh" = "Spritz-OM",
      "Hh+IAV" = "Spritz-OM+IAV",
      "Hh+IAV+NTHi" = "Spritz-OM+IAV+NTHi",
      "Saline" = "Placebo",
      "Saline+IAV" = "Placebo+IAV",
      "Saline+IAV+NTHi" = "Placebo+IAV+NTHi"
    )
  )
  
  sig_df <- sig_df %>%
  mutate(
    Treatment1 = recode(
      Treatment1,
      "Hh" = "Spritz-OM",
      "Hh+IAV" = "Spritz-OM+IAV",
      "Hh+IAV+NTHi" = "Spritz-OM+IAV+NTHi",
      "Saline" = "Placebo",
      "Saline+IAV" = "Placebo+IAV",
      "Saline+IAV+NTHi" = "Placebo+IAV+NTHi"
    ),
    Treatment2 = recode(
      Treatment2,
      "Hh" = "Spritz-OM",
      "Hh+IAV" = "Spritz-OM+IAV",
      "Hh+IAV+NTHi" = "Spritz-OM+IAV+NTHi",
      "Saline" = "Placebo",
      "Saline+IAV" = "Placebo+IAV",
      "Saline+IAV+NTHi" = "Placebo+IAV+NTHi"
    )
  )
  
  # Colors for Treatment
  my_cols <- c(
    "Placebo" = "grey",
    "Placebo+IAV" = "grey",
    "Placebo+IAV+NTHi" = "grey",
    "Spritz-OM" = "#4FAFA7",
    "Spritz-OM+IAV" = "#4FAFA7",
    "Spritz-OM+IAV+NTHi" = "#4FAFA7",
    "Pam2CSK4" = "#4A4280",
    "Pam2CSK4+IAV" = "#4A4280",
    "Pam2CSK4+IAV+NTHi" = "#4A4280"
  )
  
  # Legend selection
  legend.wanted.colour <- c("Spritz-OM", "Pam2CSK4", "Placebo")
  legend.labels.colour <- c(
    "Hh" = "Spritz-OM",
    "Pam2CSK4" = "Pam2CSK4",
    "Saline" = "Placebo"
  )
  
    # Sets Treatment order for graphing
  treatment_order <- c(
    "Placebo",
    "Spritz-OM",
    "Pam2CSK4",
    "Placebo+IAV",
    "Spritz-OM+IAV",
    "Pam2CSK4+IAV",
    "Placebo+IAV+NTHi",
    "Spritz-OM+IAV+NTHi",
    "Pam2CSK4+IAV+NTHi"
  )
  
  data_list_element <- data_list_element %>%
    mutate(
      Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = treatment_order)
    )
  
  # Compute significance y-positions robustly
  rng <- range(data_list_element[["Cell_Freq"]], na.rm = TRUE)
  value.range <- diff(rng)
  value.min <- rng[1]
  
  ifelse(
    (length(rng) == 1),
    value.splits <- 40L, 
    value.splits <- (rng[2] - rng[1]) * 0.1 # Adjust here for levels
  )
         
  vector.levels <- seq(from = value.min, to = value.min + 300, by = value.splits)
  vector.treatments <- unique(data_list_element$Treatment)
  
  df.maxValues <- data_list_element %>%
    group_by(Tissue, Timepoint, Treatment) %>%
    slice_max(Cell_Freq, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    select(Tissue, Timepoint, Treatment, Cell_Freq)
  
  df.sig.temp <- sig_df %>%
    filter(
      Annotation == name,
      (Treatment1 %in% vector.treatments & Treatment2 %in% vector.treatments)
    ) %>%
    left_join(df.maxValues, by = c("Tissue", "Timepoint", "Treatment1" = "Treatment")) %>%
    rename(Cell_Freq_g1 = Cell_Freq) %>%
    left_join(df.maxValues, by = c("Tissue", "Timepoint", "Treatment2" = "Treatment")) %>%
    rename(Cell_Freq_g2 = Cell_Freq) %>%
    filter(significance != "") %>%
    mutate(
      max_cf  = pmax(Cell_Freq_g1, Cell_Freq_g2, na.rm = TRUE),
      min_idx = pmin(length(vector.levels), findInterval(max_cf, vector.levels) + 1),
      min_level = vector.levels[min_idx]
    ) %>%
    distinct(Tissue, Timepoint, Treatment1, Treatment2, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    group_by(Tissue, Timepoint) %>%
    mutate(
      row = row_number(),
      # safe anchor (avoid -Inf when all NA)
      anchor_idx = if (all(is.na(min_idx))) 1L else max(min_idx, na.rm = TRUE),
      y_idx = pmin(length(vector.levels), anchor_idx + row),
      y_pos = vector.levels[y_idx]
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  # Refactor factors and labels
  data_list_element <- data_list_element %>%
    mutate(
      Tissue    = trimws(Tissue),
      Tissue    = factor(Tissue, c("Nasal Tissue", "Nasal", "Lung", "Spleen")),
      Timepoint = paste0(Timepoint, "hrs"),
      Timepoint = factor(Timepoint, c("2hrs", "6hrs", "24hrs", "48hrs", "72hrs", "96hrs", "144hrs")),
      Treatment = factor(Treatment, names(my_cols))
    ) %>%
    droplevels()
  
  df.sig.temp <- df.sig.temp %>%
    mutate(
      Tissue    = trimws(Tissue),
      Tissue    = factor(Tissue, c("Nasal Tissue", "Nasal", "Lung", "Spleen")),
      Timepoint = paste0(Timepoint, "hrs"),
      Timepoint = factor(Timepoint, c("2hrs", "6hrs", "24hrs", "48hrs", "72hrs", "96hrs", "144hrs"))
    ) %>%
    droplevels()
  
  # Shared y-limits across tissue plots; include any annotation y-positions
  y_limits <- range(
    c(data_list_element$Cell_Freq, df.sig.temp$y_pos),
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  
  # Build one plot per Tissue (faceting only by Timepoint)
  tissues <- levels(data_list_element$Tissue)
  plots <- lapply(seq_along(tissues), function(i) {
    t <- tissues[i]
    df_tissue <- data_list_element %>%
      filter(Tissue == t, Timepoint %in% c("96hrs", "144hrs"))
    df_sig_tissue <- df.sig.temp %>%
      filter(Tissue == t, Timepoint %in% c("96hrs", "144hrs"))
    
    p_t <- ggplot(df_tissue, aes(x = Treatment, y = Cell_Freq)) +
      geom_point(aes(col = Treatment)) +
      geom_boxplot(outliers = FALSE, fill = "transparent") +
      facet_wrap(~ Timepoint, nrow = 1, drop = FALSE) +
      scale_color_manual(
        values = my_cols,
        breaks = legend.wanted.colour,
        labels = legend.labels.colour,
        name = ""
      ) +
      scale_y_continuous(limits = y_limits, expand = expansion(mult = c(0.1, 0.1))) +
      scale_x_discrete(limits = treatment_order) +
      theme_classic() +
      theme(
        plot.title         = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        strip.text.x       = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
        axis.title.x       = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x        = element_text(size = 12, angle = -90, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5),
        axis.title.y       = element_text(size = 12),
        strip.background   = element_rect(colour = "white", fill = "white"),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey80", linewidth = 0.4, linetype = 3),
        legend.position    = "none",
        plot.margin        = margin(l = 4)
      ) +
      labs(
        title = t,
        y = if (i == 1) expression("%CD45"^{"+"}) else NULL
      )
    
    # Add signif only if there are rows to annotate for this tissue
    if (nrow(df_sig_tissue) > 0) {
      p_t <- p_t +
        geom_signif(
          data = df_sig_tissue,
          aes(xmin = Treatment1, xmax = Treatment2,
              annotations = significance, y_position = y_pos),
          textsize = 5, manual = TRUE, tip_length = 0.01, vjust = 0.5
        )
    }
    
    p_t
  })
  
  # Stitch horizontally: plot1 | plot2 | plot3 (no divider)
  combined <- plots[[1]]
  if (length(plots) > 1) {
    for (i in 2:length(plots)) {
      combined <- combined | plots[[i]]
    }
    combined <- combined + plot_layout(widths = rep(1, length(plots)))
  }
  
  # Save final combined figure
  filename <- file.path("Figure3", paste0(name, ".144.png"))
  ggsave(filename, plot = combined, width = 9, height = 4.5, units = "in", dpi = 600)
  
  combined
}

# Driver
# cell_type <- unique(moa.pre$Annotation)
cell_type <- c("Neut", "iMono", "CD103+CD4+ T")
plot_list_sig <- lapply(cell_type, function(name) {
  plot_and_save(subset_list[[name]], name, sig_df = df.sig.filtered)
})
```

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
# library(ggsignif)

plot_and_save <- function(data_list_element, name, sig_df) {
  print(paste(format(Sys.time(), "%X"), name, sep = " :sig: "))
  
  # Create the ggplot object
  
  my_cols = c("Saline" = "grey",
              "Saline+IAV" = "grey",
              "Saline+IAV+NTHi" = "grey",
              "Hh" = "#4FAFA7",
              "Hh+IAV" = "#4FAFA7",
              "Hh+IAV+NTHi" = "#4FAFA7",
              "Pam2CSK4" = "#4A4280",
              "Pam2CSK4+IAV" = "#4A4280",
              "Pam2CSK4+IAV+NTHi" = "#4A4280" 
              )
  my_shapes <- c("Saline" = 16,
                 "Saline+IAV" = 4,
                 "Saline+IAV+NTHi" = 17,
                 "Hh" = 16,
                 "Hh+IAV" = 4,
                 "Hh+IAV+NTHi" = 17,
                 "Pam2CSK4" = 16,
                 "Pam2CSK4+IAV" = 4,
                 "Pam2CSK4+IAV+NTHi" = 17
                 )
  
  # Obtaining positioning for p-values
  value.splits <- (max(data_list_element[["Cell_Freq"]]) - min(data_list_element[["Cell_Freq"]])) * 0.2 # Adjust here for levels
  value.min <- min(data_list_element[["Cell_Freq"]]) 
  vector.levels <- seq(from = value.min, to = value.min + 300, by = value.splits)
  vector.treatments <- unique(data_list_element$Treatment)
  
  df.maxValues <- data_list_element %>% 
    group_by(Tissue, Timepoint, Treatment) %>%
    slice_max(Cell_Freq) %>%
    group_by(Tissue, Timepoint) %>%
    mutate(max_total = max(Cell_Freq)) %>%
    select(Tissue, Timepoint, Treatment, Cell_Freq, max_total)
  
    df.sig.temp <- sig_df %>%
      filter(Annotation == name,
             (Treatment1 %in% vector.treatments & Treatment2 %in% vector.treatments)) %>%
      left_join(df.maxValues, by = c("Tissue", "Timepoint", "Treatment1" = "Treatment")) %>%
      rename(Cell_Freq_g1 = max_total) %>%
      left_join(df.maxValues, by = c("Tissue", "Timepoint", "Treatment2" = "Treatment")) %>%
      rename(Cell_Freq_g2 = max_total) %>%
      filter(significance != "") %>%
      mutate(
        max_cf = pmax(Cell_Freq_g1, Cell_Freq_g2, na.rm = TRUE),
        # safer index for the first level strictly greater than max_cf
        min_idx = pmin(length(vector.levels), findInterval(max_cf, vector.levels) + 1),
        min_level = vector.levels[min_idx]
      ) %>%
      distinct(Tissue, Timepoint, Treatment1, Treatment2, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
      group_by(Tissue, Timepoint) %>%
      mutate(
        row = row_number(),
        # anchor at the highest required level in the group
        anchor_idx = max(min_idx, na.rm = TRUE),
        y_idx = pmin(length(vector.levels), anchor_idx + row),
        y_pos = vector.levels[y_idx]
      ) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      dplyr::arrange(pair_key)
	  
    # Manually specifying the legend
    
    legend.wanted.colour <- c("Hh", "Pam2CSK4", "Saline")
    legend.labels.colour <- c(
      "Hh" = "Hh",
      "Pam2CSK4" = "Pam2CSK4",
      "Saline" = "Saline"
    )
    
    legend.wanted.shape <- c("Hh", "Hh+IAV", "Hh+IAV+NTHi")
    legend.labels.shape <- c(
      "Hh" = "No challenge",
      "Hh+IAV" = "IAV challenge",
      "Hh+IAV+NTHi" = "IAV-NTHi challenge"
    )
    
    # Plotting data refactoring
    
    data_list_element <- data_list_element %>%
      mutate(Tissue = trimws(Tissue),
             Tissue = factor(Tissue, c("Nasal Tissue", "Nasal", "Lung", "Spleen")),
             Timepoint = factor(Timepoint, c(144))) %>%
      droplevels()
    
    df.sig.temp <- df.sig.temp %>%
      mutate(Tissue = trimws(Tissue),
             Tissue = factor(Tissue, c("Nasal Tissue", "Nasal", "Lung", "Spleen")),
             Timepoint = factor(Timepoint, c(144))) %>%
      droplevels()
    
    # Plotting data
                
  p <- ggplot(data_list_element, 
              aes(x = Treatment, y = Cell_Freq)) +
										  
       geom_point(aes(col = Treatment, shape = Treatment)) +
      geom_boxplot(outliers = FALSE,
                   fill= "transparent") + 
						  
			 
      facet_wrap2(vars(Tissue, Timepoint),
                  nrow = 1,
                  drop = FALSE, 
                  dir = "h",
                  as.table = TRUE,
                  strip = strip_nested()) +
         scale_color_manual(
           values = my_cols,
           breaks = legend.wanted.colour,
           labels = legend.labels.colour,
           name = ""
           ) +
         scale_shape_manual(
           values = my_shapes,
           breaks = legend.wanted.shape,
           labels = legend.labels.shape,
           name = ""
           ) + 
      geom_signif(data = df.sig.temp,
                  aes(xmin = Treatment1, xmax = Treatment2, annotations = significance, y_position = y_pos),
                  textsize = 5,
                  manual = TRUE,
                  tip_length = 0.01,
                  vjust = 0.5
                  ) +
      scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.1, 0.1))) +
         theme_classic() +
         theme(strip.text.x = element_text(size = 14),
               axis.title.x = element_blank(),
               axis.text.x = element_text(size=10, angle = -90, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5),
               axis.title.y = element_text(size=14),
               plot.title = element_text(size=16, face = "bold"),
               plot.tag = element_text(size=16, 
                                       face = "bold",
                                       hjust = 0,
                                       vjust = 1,
                                       margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)),
               plot.tag.position = c(0.001, 1),
               legend.position="none") +
       labs(title = name,
            tag = paste0(LETTERS[match(name, cell_type)], ")")) + 
       ylab(expression("%CD45"^{"+"})) #Indicate  y-axislimits based on cell type
  
  # Save plot
  
  plot_list_sig[[name]] <- p
    
    }
```

```{r}

adjustments_for_grid <- function(plot_list, ncol) {
    n <- length(plot_list)
    nrow <- ceiling(n / ncol)
    
    lapply(seq_along(plot_list), function(i) {
        p <- plot_list[[i]]
        
        # Remove x-axis text and title for all plots
        p <- p + theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
                       axis.title.x = element_blank())
        
        # Keep legend for first plot only (patchwork will collect later)
        if (i != 1) {
            p <- p + theme(legend.position = "none")
        }
        
        p
    })
}

# Apply adjustments
ncol <- 2
plot_list_adjusted <- adjustments_for_grid(plot_list_sig, ncol)

# Combine plots with patchwork and collect legend automatically
combined_plots <- wrap_plots(plot_list_adjusted, ncol = ncol) +
    plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
    labs(colour = "", shape = "") &
    theme(
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.text = element_text(size = 18),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "italic"),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_line(linetype = "dotted", color = "grey70"),
        legend.key.size = unit(1, "cm")
    ) &
    guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 6)),
           shape = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 6)))


# Save tiff
ggsave("supp.sig.tiff", combined_plots, height = 7000, width = 5000, units = "px")

ggsave("supp.sig.png", combined_plots, height = 7000, width = 5000, units = "px")
```
